finding_info_list.title: Suspicious interactive RDP logon to WIN-FILE01 by svc_backup
finding_info_list.desc:
Opened by: SOC Tier 1 (m.okafor) from EDR detection det-lm-001 (CrowdStrike, severity High, T1021.001 / T1059.001).

Summary as reported: at 14:32 UTC an interactive (RemoteInteractive, type 10) RDP logon to WIN-FILE01 was recorded for the account CONTOSO\svc_backup from 10.0.4.20. About 30 seconds later powershell.exe started on WIN-FILE01 with an encoded command line. WIN-FILE01 is the finance file server (asset tier: high).

Tier 1 triage notes:
- svc_backup is the backup service account. Tier 1 expected it to authenticate from the backup server BKP-01, not from a workstation subnet address.
- 10.0.4.20 is in the user workstation range; owner not identified at time of escalation.
- The backup team on-call did not answer. Whether anyone on that team was doing hands-on work on WIN-FILE01 today is UNCONFIRMED.
- No containment taken. Host remains on the network pending Tier 2 investigation.

Requested of Tier 2: determine whether this is lateral movement with stolen service credentials or legitimate administrative use, and contain if malicious.

Work notes:
2026-04-20 14:41 UTC m.okafor — Incident created from det-lm-001, assigned to SOC Tier 2.
2026-04-20 14:52 UTC m.okafor — Paged backup on-call, no answer. Escalating as P2 given asset tier.
